new.story: A 1984 Bahamian 5 cent piece with the national coat of arms — the Santa Maria ship, a flamingo and blue marlin holding the shield. The motto reads Forward, Upward, Onward Together. The other side shows a pineapple with FIVE CENTS.
new.notes: Blind double-read. COMMONWEALTH OF THE BAHAMAS / 1984 read from enlargement. SUPERSEDES changes_muse_20261012-2130.jsonl which misfiled this as 25c — owner corrected to 5c, confirmed against Numista N#5010 (21.00mm, KM#60).
